name: agentic-delivery-guardrails
description: Guardrails and a runnable claim-checker for AI-assisted delivery.
//: The claim-check CLI (claim-check/claim-check.js) is dependency-free and runs on Node 14+. This package.json exists only to run the regression suite, which uses the built-in node:test module and therefore needs Node 18+. No 'engines' field is declared on purpose, so the test tooling's Node 18 requirement is not misread as the CLI's runtime requirement.
